{"metadata":{"description":"A plugin that adds a desktop pet to your DeepSeek Harness, supporting the Codex pet format.","id":"gh:1333917329","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-desktop-pet","slug":"sereinmono/dsh-desktop-pet","topics":["desktop-pet","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","pet"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A plugin that adds a desktop pet to your DeepSeek Harness, supporting the Codex pet format."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-desktop-pet"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"An **optional desktop companion** for deepseek-harness. It shows a small animated pet as an ambient "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"status indicator: the pet relaxes when the harness is idle, "thinks" while the model reasons, "works"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"" while tools run, waits when the harness needs input, and celebrates (or frowns) when a turn finish"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"hile tools run, waits when the harness needs input, and celebrates (or frowns) when a turn finishes."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It is **not** a second chat UI, a task manager, or a full desktop app. It is a status indicator."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Plugin-first**: a normal deepseek-harness plugin — no separately launched daemon, browser, or de"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"sktop app.
- **Zero network**: all assets ship with the plugin; no telemetry, CDN, or remote service"},{"id":"p6s3","text":".
- **Zero added LLM cost**: event → state resolution is fully deterministic.
- **Runtime-discovered"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" pets**: pets under `assets/pets/` (bundled) and `~/.dsh/desktop-pet/pets/` (user-imported) are disc"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"overed at startup, so adding a pet is dropping a folder in — no rebuild."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The plugin is a Cordis **bundle** that ships both a host half (the pet window)
and a client half (th"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"e settings card). `dsh plugin add` installs it and, because
the manifest declares `dsh.bundle`, adds"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" it to the profile's bundle list
automatically."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### From npm"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### From a local directory"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Install the plugin directly from its source directory (the profile keeps it as
a `link:` dependency)"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"nstall the plugin directly from its source directory (the profile keeps it as
a `link:` dependency):"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"On Windows, for example:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"You can also run `dsh plugin --profile <name> add .` from inside the plugin
directory."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### From a tarball"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Pack the plugin, then install the tarball:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### From a Git repository"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"If the repository does not commit build artifacts, configure a `prepare`
script so `dsh plugin add` "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"builds the plugin during install."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Run"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"> If you are running Harness from a source checkout, prefix the commands above
> with `pnpm` — i.e. "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"run `pnpm dsh plugin ...` and `pnpm dsh ...` from the
> Harness repository."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"> The settings card requires Harness to expose the `desktop-pet` settings
> namespace (via its `WEB_"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"SETTINGS_NAMESPACES` allowlist). The pet window itself
> does not depend on that allowlist."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### Enable / disable"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Set `enabled: false` in the plugin's config, or remove the bundle from the
profile. The plugin then "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"loads but shows nothing; removing it entirely leaves
Harness fully functional."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Adding a pet"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Pets are plain folders following a fixed sprite-sheet format. Imported pets
live in the **user pets "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"directory** (`~/.dsh/desktop-pet/pets/<id>/`), outside
the installed package, so they survive plugin"},{"id":"p30s3","text":" upgrades. Three common ways to
obtain one are covered in the dedicated guide, each with a copy-past"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"e prompt
and manual steps — and the settings card offers buttons for two of them
(import from a fold"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"er, and import from Petdex):"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- **hatch-pet** — generate a pet with the skill, then drop its output folder into `~/.dsh/desktop-pe"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"t/pets/`.
- **Import an existing folder** — copy a folder containing `pet.json` + `spritesheet.webp`"},{"id":"p31s3","text":" into `~/.dsh/desktop-pet/pets/`.
- **Petdex community** — download a community pet with `npx petdex"},{"id":"p31s4","text":" install <slug>` and copy it in."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"See **Adding a Pet** for the full walkthrough, and the
**asset format reference** for the
exact `pet"},{"id":"p32s2","text":".json` and sprite-sheet layout."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Supported platforms"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| Platform | Status |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| Windows 11 | ✅ primary target (transparent overlay via Neutralinojs / WebView2) |
| Linux (X11 / W"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"ayland) | ✅ (Neutralinojs / WebKitGTK; **requires a compositor + WebKitGTK**) |
| macOS | ⚠️ rendere"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"r is ready; needs a packaged runtime binary + manual verification |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"The overlay is rendered by Neutralinojs, which uses the OS webview (WebView2 on Windows, WebKitGTK o"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"n Linux, WKWebView on macOS). Linux needs `libwebkit2gtk` (GNOME/KDE ship it; lightweight distros ma"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"y need to install it) and a running compositor for per-pixel transparency."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"All fields are optional and validated with a Schemastery schema (invalid values fail loudly at load)"},{"id":"p38s2","text":". The user-editable fields (`enabled`, `petScale`, `petId`, `hideWhenIdle`) are exposed on the Web s"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"itable fields (`enabled`, `petScale`, `petId`, `hideWhenIdle`) are exposed on the Web settings card."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"| Field | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch. |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"- **`HarnessBridge`** is the only module that knows raw harness event names. Everything above it is "},{"id":"p43s2","text":"harness-independent.
- **Pet core** (`core/`) is a standalone library: testable with no harness, no "},{"id":"p43s3","text":"window, no network.
- **Backends** are platform-isolated behind `WindowBackend`; the renderer never "},{"id":"p43s4","text":"sees platform details. The Neutralino backend drives a small frontend that loads the sprite sheet an"},{"id":"p43s5","text":"d draws frames — the host only sends `(pose, frameIndex)` directives.
- **Client half** (`src/client"},{"id":"p43s6","text":"/`) is a separate browser bundle registered through the harness module loader; the host and client h"},{"id":"p43s7","text":"alves communicate through the settings namespace."},{"id":"p44s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"- **Linux needs WebKitGTK + a compositor**; lightweight distros may need `libwebkit2gtk-4.0` install"},{"id":"p45s2","text":"ed manually.
- **macOS is not yet verified** — the renderer is platform-neutral and the runtime bina"},{"id":"p45s3","text":"ry is packaged by the installer, but it has not been manually tested.
- **Click-through is not suppo"},{"id":"p45s4","text":"rted**: Neutralino transparent windows have no per-window pointer-passthrough API, so `clickThrough`"},{"id":"p45s5","text":" is ignored (with a warning).
- **Transparent-window dead zone** (Windows): the bottom ~20% of a Neu"},{"id":"p45s6","text":"tralino transparent window does not receive pointer input (upstream neutralinojs#1482). The pet is d"},{"id":"p45s7","text":"rawn in the top 75% of the window to keep drag/hover/click fully working.
- The bundled placeholder "},{"id":"p45s8","text":"is the `text` test pet only — original SVG-drawn text, with no OpenAI/Codex/DeepSeek character artwo"},{"id":"p45s9","text":"rk or trademarks.
- Overlay rendering (frameless/transparent/topmost/drag) has not been exercised by"},{"id":"p45s10","text":" automated CI and needs a manual check on a real desktop."}],"truncated":true}
